item.title: IND vs NZ 5th T20I Highlights: Arshdeep Singh, Ishan Kishan star as India thrash New Zealand by 46 runs, win series 4-1
item.description: IND vs NZ 5th T20I Highlights: Ishan Kishan smashed a blistering maiden T20I hundred while Suryakumar Yadav hit a stroke-filled fifty as India defeated New Zealand by 46 runs in the fifth and final T20I at the Greenfield International Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram on Saturday and to seal the series 4-1. India, returning to full strength after their setback in Visakhapatnam, posted 271/5 - their third-highest total in the format. Kishan smashed 103 off 43 balls, laced with six fours and ten sixes
